overviewParagraphs: Silk Path Dong Trieu Golf is Northern Vietnam's most expansive golf facility — a 27-hole layout spread across rolling hills that blend parkland character with the natural topography of Quang Ninh Province. The three interchangeable nine-hole loops offer golfers significant variety without the repetition that can come with playing the same 18 holes again.

The parkland corridors provide tree-lined definition and visual intimacy, while the hillside sections open up to broader views and more exposed, strategic play. The combination creates a highly varied round — or rounds — across any combination of nines the visiting golfer chooses.

Located in the Ha Long Bay region, Silk Path Dong Trieu is an excellent pairing with FLC Ha Long Bay Golf Club for a two-day golf experience in one of Vietnam's most scenically spectacular provinces. AGS builds Ha Long / Quang Ninh itineraries combining both courses with bay cruises and overnight resort stays.

curatorBriefHtml: Silk Path Dong Trieu Golf is a premier Par 72 championship layout in Quang Ninh, Vietnam, crafted by Sir Nick Faldo (2025) and stretching to 6,858 Yards (Blue Tees) across a rolling hills, parkland corridors environment. In Asia Golf Specialists' (AGS) field evaluations, the course stands out for its 27-hole strategic routing variety (Hill, Lake & Valley nines) and pristine fairway carpet conditioning (Top-tier grass maintenance).

From an itinerary-engineering perspective, Silk Path Dong Trieu Golf (Resort & Visitor Access via AGS) requires advance flight allocation and experienced local caddie pairing—particularly during the peak Vietnam dry season. Our curatorial scorecard specifically notes its caddie professionalism & pacing (Exemplary 5-star standards), making pre-reserved morning tee times and private door-to-clubhouse VIP transfers essential for maintaining pace of play.

When integrated into a multi-round Quang Ninh golf tour by AGS, Silk Path Dong Trieu Golf provides a distinct architectural test by Sir Nick Faldo that complements neighboring regional layouts while keeping daily hotel-to-tee transfer times streamlined.

scorecard.verdict: A brand-new 27-hole luxury golf oasis nestled in Quang Ninh province. Features rolling hills, crystal-clear water lakes, and the signature 5-star service of Silk Path hospitality.

faqs.q: What are the key course specifications for Silk Path Dong Trieu Golf?
faqs.a: Silk Path Dong Trieu Golf in Quang Ninh, Vietnam is a Par 72 championship layout designed by Sir Nick Faldo (opened 2025), measuring 6,858 Yards (Blue Tees) within a rolling hills, parkland corridors setting. It is particularly noted for 27-hole strategic routing variety (Hill, Lake & Valley nines).

faqs.q: How do I secure tee times and caddies at Silk Path Dong Trieu Golf?
faqs.a: Silk Path Dong Trieu Golf operates under resort & visitor access via ags protocols. Asia Golf Specialists secures guaranteed morning tee times, compulsory caddie and cart pairings (caddie professionalism & pacing (Exemplary 5-star standards)), and private VIP transfers from your Quang Ninh hotel as part of a custom golf itinerary.

faqs.q: What playing conditions and turf can golfers expect at Silk Path Dong Trieu Golf?
faqs.a: Our field inspection highlights Silk Path Dong Trieu Golf's pristine fairway carpet conditioning (Top-tier grass maintenance) alongside 27-hole strategic routing variety (Hill, Lake & Valley nines). Standard championship golf attire (collared shirts, tailored trousers or shorts, and soft-spike golf shoes) is strictly enforced by the starter.

faqs.q: What is the best time of year to play Silk Path Dong Trieu Golf?
faqs.a: October through April is the best season for Silk Path Dong Trieu Golf.
